title: Support `uv tool audit`
author: woodruffw
body_preview: ### Summary  We should support `uv tool audit` for auditing installed tools, similarly to how we support `uv audit`.  Two basic flows:  - `uv tool audit` audits _all_ installed tools; - `uv tool audit <tool>` audits the locked resolution for just `<tool>`.  Part of https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/18506.  ### Example  ```shell uv tool audit uv tool audit cowsay ```
